description:
An award-winning, open-source video editor

OpenShot Video Editor is an award-winning, open-source video editor, available on Linux, Mac, Chrome OS, and Windows. OpenShot can create stunning videos, films, and animations with an easy-to-use interface and rich set of features.
Highlights & Features:
- New Color View with color wheels, curves, LUT controls, presets, and live video
  scopes
- New Recording View for screen, webcam, microphone, and system-audio capture
- Redesigned native Qt timeline with smoother zooming, editable timecode, and improved
  keyframe controls
- New clip menus and creative presets for motion, camera moves, color, film looks,
  lighting, and audio
- Local AI model downloads and workflows for Object Mask and Object Detection
- Improved Qt 6, PySide6, Wayland, high-DPI, and modern Linux compatibility
- Updated export presets, documentation, translations, and hundreds of usability and
  stability fixes
